instruction: Now you are in a washroom facing wall and two pictures. Turn around. Move forward near the brown table. Turn right. Move forward to the fridge. Move forward crossing a table and a chair. Turn slightly left. Go inside the opening. Turn slightly left. Move forward to the pillar. Turn left. Go outside of the open door. Move forward and stand in between the two pillars in front of the two flower pots. You have reached your destination.
